verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents deploying custom fine-tuned models to dedicated endpoints, uploaded from your S3 bucket with version tracking, so the serving half of the story is first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows Cerebras running fine-tuning jobs on your data, so training must happen elsewhere and the 'same platform' loop is not closed. Missing for 10: on-platform fine-tuning of a supported base model on user data, a documented list of supported base models for fine-tuning, serving outside dedicated endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune a supported base model on my own data and serve the result on the same platform

citations.quote: Deploy your custom fine-tuned models alongside standard model variants.
Upload fine-tuned models from your S3 bucket, track multiple versions, and deploy them to your [dedicated endpoint](/dedicated/overview).
